sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这里是《访谈》。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia-Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Fry knows that what is playing out on the streets of his city will have profound implications for the whole country.
sentences.zh: 明尼阿波利斯市长雅各布·弗雷深知，在他城市街头正在上演的一切，将对整个国家产生深远的影响。

sentences.en: Since December, there's been an influx of thousands of federal agents into Minneapolis as part of what the Department of Homeland Security has termed Operation Metro Surge.
sentences.zh: 自12月以来，数千名联邦特工涌入明尼阿波利斯，这是国土安全部所谓的“地铁激增行动”的一部分。

sentences.en: And Fry has had to shepherd a city riven by protests, infuriated by the killing of two American citizens at the hands of ICE and CBP, and shaken by aggressive immigration raids
sentences.zh: 弗雷不得不安抚一座四分五裂的城市，这里抗议不断，因美国公民死于移民及海关执法局（ICE）和海关与边境保护局（CBP）之手而愤怒，并被激进的移民突袭所震撼

sentences.en: that have left some residents afraid to leave their homes.
sentences.zh: 这使得一些居民不敢离开家门。

sentences.en: I spoke to Mayor Frye on Thursday afternoon, not long after Border Czar Tom Homan, who's been dispatched to Minneapolis, promised to de-escalate the situation there.
sentences.zh: 我在周四下午采访了市长弗雷，不久前，被派往明尼阿波利斯的边境沙皇汤姆·霍曼承诺缓和那里的局势。

sentences.en: He said in a press conference that there would be a drawdown of agents, only to have President Trump later deny that there was any plan to pull back.
sentences.zh: 他在新闻发布会上表示将撤回特工，但随后特朗普总统否认有任何撤军计划。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, protests against ICE have now spread nationwide, and Congressional Democrats are pushing for reform of an immigration enforcement agency that they say is out of control.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，抗议ICE的活动现已蔓延至全国，国会民主党人正推动改革一个他们认为已经失控的移民执法机构。

sentences.en: For its part, the federal government is promising to crack down on the protesters, and the Justice Department has opened an investigation into Minnesota elected officials,
sentences.zh: 就联邦政府而言，它承诺严厉打击抗议者，司法部已对明尼苏达州民选官员展开调查，

sentences.en: including Mayor Frye and Minnesota Governor Tim Walz, for what they allege is a conspiracy to impede federal immigration agents.
sentences.zh: 包括市长弗雷和明尼苏达州长蒂姆·沃尔兹，罪名是涉嫌密谋阻挠联邦移民特工。

sentences.en: While there are many differing opinions on what is happening in Minneapolis, it's clear that this confrontation between the federal government,
sentences.zh: 尽管对于明尼阿波利斯正在发生的事情存在许多不同的看法，但显然，联邦政府、

sentences.en: a state, and its people is an inflection point.
sentences.zh: 一个州及其人民之间的这场对抗是一个转折点。

sentences.en: For the view on how this conflict is playing out on the ground, and where it might be headed, here's my conversation with Mayor Jacob Frye.
sentences.zh: 为了解这场冲突在实地如何展开以及可能走向何方，以下是我与市长雅各布·弗雷的对话。

sentences.en: Mayor Frye, thank you so much for being here.
sentences.zh: 弗雷市长，非常感谢您能来。

sentences.en: I really appreciate you taking the time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您抽出时间。

sentences.en: We are here in Capitol Hill, normally not where you find yourself, but you obviously have been taking meetings today, you've been at a mayor's meeting,
sentences.zh: 我们现在在国会山，通常这不是您会待的地方，但您今天显然一直在开会，您参加了一个市长会议，

sentences.en: and I want to talk to you about that in a little bit, but I actually want to start our conversation by asking about a phone call
sentences.zh: 我等一下想跟您聊聊这个，但其实我想先问一个电话来开启我们的对话，

sentences.en: that you had with President Trump earlier this week.
sentences.zh: 那是您本周早些时候与特朗普总统通的电话。

sentences.en: I'd love to get your sense of that conversation, and if you can just describe that call to me.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听您对那次通话的感受，您能为我描述一下那通电话吗？

sentences.en: First off, never in a million years did I think that I would be having a phone call with President Trump about this large-scale invasion
sentences.zh: 首先，我做梦也没想到会因为这场大规模入侵而与特朗普总统通电话，

sentences.en: that we're experiencing in the city that I love, so none of this feels normal.
sentences.zh: 而入侵正发生在我热爱的城市里，所以这一切感觉都不正常。

sentences.en: Yeah, I had a reach out from the chief of staff in Susie Wiles saying that the president was looking to talk to me.
sentences.zh: 对，我接到了参谋长苏西·威尔斯的联络，说总统想跟我谈谈。

sentences.en: We had already reached out maybe a couple of weeks prior looking to have some form of audience with the president so that we could explain how damaging Operation Metro Surge
sentences.zh: 我们大约在几周前就已经主动联系过，希望能以某种形式获得总统的接见，以便我们解释“地铁激增行动”

sentences.en: has been to Minneapolis and continues to be.
sentences.zh: 对明尼阿波利斯造成的破坏有多大，并且这种破坏仍在继续。

sentences.en: A call was scheduled.
sentences.zh: 通话就这样安排好了。

sentences.en: Look, it was a relatively collegial conversation.
sentences.zh: 听着，那是一次相对友好的对话。

sentences.en: He was flattering, certainly, at firSt.
sentences.zh: 一开始，他当然说了一些奉承的话。

sentences.en: Flattering how?
sentences.zh: 怎么个奉承法？

sentences.en: What did he say?
sentences.zh: 他说了什么？

sentences.en: He said that I was impressive on the television, in different words, I'm sure.
sentences.zh: 他说我在电视上的表现令人印象深刻，当然，他用的是不同的词。

sentences.en: Yeah, he watches a lot of TV and watches people's performances.
sentences.zh: 对，他看了很多电视，也看人们的表现。

sentences.en: And what did you say?
sentences.zh: 那你说了什么？

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I said thank you.
sentences.zh: 我说谢谢。

sentences.en: I said, well, I must have gotten it from my ma, who is from Queens.
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，我这可能是遗传自我妈，她来自皇后区。

sentences.en: And, of course, we talked about Flushing and Fresh Meadows where my mother grew up.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们聊了聊我母亲长大的法拉盛和新鲜草甸。

sentences.en: And we talked just initially about the East Coast, and then, of course, I made a clear ask that Operation Metro Surge needed to end.
sentences.zh: 我们一开始只是聊了聊东海岸，然后，我当然明确提出要求，即“地铁激增行动”必须结束。

sentences.en: And, you know, without getting into too many specifics, I will tell you there was a broad recognition that the present status is not okay.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在不涉及太多具体细节的情况下，我可以告诉你，双方广泛认识到现状是不可接受的。

sentences.en: What is happening needs to change.
sentences.zh: 正在发生的事情必须改变。

sentences.en: And, of course, there were some changes made, certainly in terms of who is leading the operation in Minneapolis, a shift from a combination of Bovino and Nome to Homan.
sentences.zh: 当然，也做出了一些改变，尤其是在明尼阿波利斯的行动领导层方面，从博维诺和诺姆的组合转变成了霍曼。

sentences.en: But as far as massive changes in this operation,
sentences.zh: 但就这次行动的重大改变而言，

sentences.en: I'll believe it when I see it.
sentences.zh: 我会拭目以待。

sentences.en: The troops and the federal agents need to be drawn down entirely.
sentences.zh: 军队和联邦特工需要彻底撤离。

sentences.en: This operation needs to end because it has been devastating to the people that I care about and I love in my city.
sentences.zh: 这次行动必须结束，因为它对我市我关爱和挚爱的人民造成了毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: And you imparted that message to the president at that time.
sentences.zh: 而你当时就把这个信息传达给了总统。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: The president initially said you had a good call, and then he was pretty complimentary, right, in public.
sentences.zh: 总统最初说你们通了一通好电话，然后他在公开场合也相当赞赏，对吧？

sentences.en: But he posted that you were, quote, playing with fire for not being willing to enforce federal immigration laws, which sounds like a warning.
sentences.zh: 但他发文称你“玩火”，因为你不愿意执行联邦移民法，这听起来像是一个警告。

sentences.en: I mean, how did you take those words?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你是怎么看待这些话的？

sentences.en: We were never going to agree, and we have not agreed to enforce federal immigration law.
sentences.zh: 我们从来没有，也没有同意去执行联邦移民法。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: First off, it's not our job.
sentences.zh: 首先，这不是我们的工作。

sentences.en: Uh, I want our police officers doing their own work, not somebody else's.
sentences.zh: 呃，我希望我们的警官做他们自己的工作，而不是别人的。

sentences.en: I want our police officers doing the important work of keeping Minneapolis residents safe, responding to 911 calls, stopping carjackings, preventing murders,
sentences.zh: 我希望我们的警官做好保障明尼阿波利斯居民安全的重要工作，回应911报警，制止劫车，防止谋杀，

sentences.en: the work of a police officer in a major city.
sentences.zh: 这是一个大城市警察该做的工作。

sentences.en: You know what I don't want them doing?
sentences.zh: 你知道我不想让他们做什么吗？

sentences.en: I don't want them spending a single minute hunting down a father that just dropped his kids off at daycare, who's about to go work a 12-hour shift, who happens to be from Ecuador.
sentences.zh: 我不想让他们浪费哪怕一分钟去搜捕一个刚刚把孩子送到日托中心、正准备去上12小时夜班、恰好来自厄瓜多尔的父亲。

sentences.en: Um, by the way, this is not some wild, out-there, like, radical leftist principle.
sentences.zh: 嗯，顺便说一句，这并不是什么疯狂的、离谱的、激进的左翼原则。

sentences.en: This is a concept that even Rudy Giuliani as mayor of New York City adopted.
sentences.zh: 这是一个连作为纽约市长的鲁迪·朱利安尼都采纳的概念。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because he wants everybody, including people that are undocumented, to feel comfortable calling 911 when something goes down.
sentences.zh: 因为他希望每个人，包括没有身份的人，在出事时都能安心拨打911。

sentences.en: If you see a crime, call 911.
sentences.zh: 如果你看到犯罪，就拨打911。

sentences.en: Rudy Giuliani, the radical leftist Rudy, recognized that when he was mayor, and it's a concept that I think mayors around the country also recognize now.
sentences.zh: 鲁迪·朱利安尼，这个激进的左翼鲁迪，当市长时就意识到了这一点，我认为现在全国各地的市长也都意识到了这个概念。

sentences.en: After that call,
sentences.zh: 那通电话之后，

sentences.en: Bordersar Tom Homan was dispatched to Minneapolis to replace, as you mentioned, Gregory Bovino, who had been running the operation.
sentences.zh: 边境沙皇汤姆·霍曼被派往明尼阿波利斯，正如你所提到的，接替了一直在负责该行动的格雷戈里·博维诺。

sentences.en: And Tom Homan gave a press conference where he described interactions with local leaders, including you, as moving in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·霍曼举行了一场新闻发布会，将与包括你在内的地方领导人的互动描述为朝着正确方向迈进。

sentences.en: The word that has been used is de-escalation.
sentences.zh: 一直被使用的词是“缓和”。

sentences.en: And I'm unclear what that de-escalation actually looks like because what the federal government has been asking for is that cooperation.
sentences.zh: 我不清楚这种缓和实际到底是什么样子的，因为联邦政府一直要求的是合作。

sentences.en: You're saying it's not going to come.
sentences.zh: 而你说合作是不会有的。

sentences.en: So what exactly is it going to, practically speaking, look like if indeed things are going to de-escalate in your city?
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你们城市的局势真的要缓和，从实际角度来讲，这到底会是什么样子？

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about what cooperation could look like.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈合作会是什么样子。

sentences.en: We do cooperate with this federal administration and with previous federal administrations on keeping people safe in our city.
sentences.zh: 我们确实与本届联邦政府以及之前的联邦政府就维护我们城市的安全进行了合作。

sentences.en: So if the goal is to drive down homicides and go after murderers, let's do it.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果目标是压低凶杀率并追捕杀人犯，那就干吧。

sentences.en: You know, we have worked with the FBI and the DEA and the ATF and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们一直与联邦调查局、缉毒局、烟酒枪炮及爆炸物管理局以及美国

sentences.en: Attorney's Office and successfully driven down crime and specifically shootings to record lows on the north side of Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 检察官办公室合作，成功将明尼阿波利斯北区的犯罪率特别是枪击事件降至历史最低点。

sentences.en: We're willing to do that work right now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在就愿意做那项工作。

sentences.en: Now, if they want to have strategic and thoughtful work that is targeted at criminals, the answer is yes.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果他们想开展针对罪犯的、具有战略性和深思熟虑的工作，答案是肯定的。

sentences.en: But why does this have to be about immigration?
sentences.zh: 但为什么这必须跟移民扯上关系呢？

sentences.en: You know, why does it have to be about whether a person has brown-colored skin or not?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，为什么这必须跟一个人的皮肤是不是棕色有关呢？

sentences.en: Well, the point that they're making is that this is about immigration enforcement, which is obviously part of the federal government's job and always has been.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们提出的观点是，这关乎移民执法，这显然是联邦政府工作的一部分，而且一直都是。

sentences.en: So, again, I guess the question is, I mean, you've talked to Tom Homan now.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想问题依然是，我是说，你现在已经和汤姆·霍曼谈过了。

sentences.en: What are they asking for and what are you willing to give?
sentences.zh: 他们在要求什么，你又愿意付出什么？

sentences.en: And vice versa, what are they willing to concede?
sentences.zh: 反过来，他们又愿意作出什么妥协？

sentences.en: Well, as far as de-escalation goes, they are saying that they will draw down the resources and personnel that they have located in our city, which, by the way, is ridiculous
sentences.zh: 好吧，就缓和局势而言，他们表示将缩减部署在我们城市的资源和人员，顺便说一句，这些资源和人员

sentences.en: and incredibly disproportionate.
sentences.zh: 极其荒谬且极不对称。

sentences.en: We've got 600 police officers.
sentences.zh: 我们有600名警察。

sentences.en: They have between 3,000 and 4,000 federal agents,
sentences.zh: 他们有3,000到4,000名联邦特工，

sentences.en: ICE and Border Patrol.
sentences.zh: 包括ICE和边境巡逻队。

sentences.en: They are saying, and I'm hopeful that they are being honest and candid, that those numbers will be significantly drawn down.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，我希望他们是诚实和坦率的，这些数字将会大幅减少。

sentences.en: They are saying that the way that ICE and Border Patrol has been conducting themselves will change dramatically.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，ICE和边境巡逻队以往的行为方式将发生巨大改变。

sentences.en: So, you know, not these kind of marauding gangs of guys just walking down the street indiscriminately picking people up, but having more of a targeted operation.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，不会再有那种成群结队、在街上游荡、不加区别地抓人的暴徒式行径，而是会有更多针对性的行动。

sentences.en: And look, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，

sentences.en: this is not about ICE doing regular ICE stuff.
sentences.zh: 这并不是指阻止ICE做他们日常的常规工作。

sentences.en: What we have seen feels like an invasion.
sentences.zh: 我们所看到的简直就像是一场入侵。

sentences.en: I'm sure you've heard that a judge has said that ICE has violated nearly 100 court orders since its crackdown began in Minneapolis,
sentences.zh: 我确信你已经听说，一位法官表示，自明尼阿波利斯开展打击行动以来，ICE已经违反了近100项法院命令，

sentences.en: which makes me wonder if you think you can enforce any agreement really with Hohman and the federal government considering that context.
sentences.zh: 这让我不禁怀疑，考虑到这一背景，你是否认为自己真的能执行与霍曼及联邦政府达成的任何协议。

sentences.en: That's the most dangerous question that anybody can ask because we are in a world of hurt that goes way beyond any individual safety if we are talking about a federal government
sentences.zh: 这是任何人都能提出的最危险的问题，因为如果我们谈论的是一个完全无视法院命令的联邦政府，

sentences.en: completely ignoring court orders.
sentences.zh: 我们正陷入一场远超任何个人安全的巨大困境中。

sentences.en: This is a foundational principle of our republic, and the battlefield that we fight on as municipalities and cities around the country
sentences.zh: 这是我们共和国的基本原则，作为全国各地的市镇和城市，我们所据以战斗的战场

sentences.en: isn't one of warfare.
sentences.zh: 不是战争的战场。

sentences.en: It is one of the law.
sentences.zh: 它是法律的战场。

sentences.en: The battlefield that we fight on and the battlefield that we are going to win on is the law.
sentences.zh: 我们战斗的战场以及我们终将获胜的战场就是法律。

sentences.en: A precondition of that necessary fight is that once the law has been determined and a court order comes down, that it's going to be followed.
sentences.zh: 这场必要战斗的前提条件是，一旦法律确定并且法院下达了命令，就必须予以遵守。

sentences.en: And so this is something that I get really intense and really pissed off about.
sentences.zh: 因此，每当想到这里，我都感到无比紧张和气愤。

sentences.en: This is not optional.
sentences.zh: 这不是可选的。

sentences.en: You follow the law.
sentences.zh: 你必须遵守法律。

sentences.en: A court order comes down.
sentences.zh: 法院下达了命令。

sentences.en: That's what this is about.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题的关键所在。

sentences.en: And we should have everybody,
sentences.zh: 我们所有的人，

sentences.en: Democrat and Republicans, losing it.
sentences.zh: 无论民主党人还是共和党人，都应该为此抓狂。

sentences.en: It should be deeply concerning, not from an ideological perspective, but from an American one.
sentences.zh: 这应该引起深深的担忧，不是从意识形态的角度，而是从美国人的角度。

sentences.en: What are the options if they don't do that?
sentences.zh: 如果他们不这样做，还有什么选择？

sentences.en: The options you don't even want to think about.
sentences.zh: 那些选择你甚至都不愿去想。

sentences.en: I mean, I see where you're leading me and you're doing the right...
